dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「全てのはじまりは……そう、ある魔法使いが
　見た夢からだった」
dialogues.en: "Yes. It started in a dream that a witch had."
dialogues.text: "Yes. It started in a dream that a witch had."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう……夢の世界へようこそ」
dialogues.en: "Good morning. Welcome to the world of dreams."
dialogues.text: "Good morning. Welcome to the world of dreams."

dialogues.jp:
狂ったように桜が散り、舞い、跳ね、朽ち、そ
の養分を吸いとって咲き、また散る世界。
dialogues.en:
This is the world where the cherry blossoms go mad, fly,
jump, decay, and bloom again by absorbing all nutrients from
them.
dialogues.text:
This is the world where the cherry blossoms go mad, fly,
jump, decay, and bloom again by absorbing all nutrients from
them.

dialogues.jp: 果てまでも桜の木が埋め尽くす夜。
dialogues.en:
The night is filled with rows of cherry trees as far as the
eye can see.
dialogues.text:
The night is filled with rows of cherry trees as far as the
eye can see.

dialogues.jp: 月は丸く高く浮く。
dialogues.en: The moon is round, floating high in the sky.
dialogues.text: The moon is round, floating high in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんに会う前に、消えようと思ってた
　んだけどな……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought I was going to disappear before you came in,
oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"I thought I was going to disappear before you came in,
oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
木の周りをぐるぐる、と回りながらさくらが寂
しそうに微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles sadly, circling around the tree.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles sadly, circling around the tree.

dialogues.jp:
そこでようやく、自分がココにいることを認識
した。
dialogues.en: I finally recognize my existence right here.
dialogues.text: I finally recognize my existence right here.

dialogues.jp: 「さくら……いや、違う？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura... No, it's not?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura... No, it's not?"

dialogues.jp: なにか、雰囲気が違う。
dialogues.en: There's something different about her.
dialogues.text: There's something different about her.

dialogues.jp:
こいつが、事件などの時に目撃される｛・・・／サクラ｝な
のだろう。
dialogues.en:
I guess this must be the Sakura who was seen at the
incidents.
dialogues.text:
I guess this must be the Sakura who was seen at the
incidents.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。ボクは夢の中のさくらなのかな？
　この枯れない桜であるかも知れない」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, I am. Am I Sakura only in the dream? I could be a
cherry petal that won't die."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, I am. Am I Sakura only in the dream? I could be a
cherry petal that won't die."

dialogues.jp: くすくす、と笑う。
dialogues.en: She chuckles.
dialogues.text: She chuckles.

dialogues.jp: 「全部、お前がやっていることなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you controlling all of this?"
dialogues.text: "Are you controlling all of this?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「全部ってどこまで？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by all?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by all?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「枯れない桜、音夢の病気、事故や事件、不思
　議な力……この夢」
dialogues.en:
"I mean the cherry blossoms that never die, Nemu's sickness,
the accidents, the tragedy, the strange power... and this
dream."
dialogues.text:
"I mean the cherry blossoms that never die, Nemu's sickness,
the accidents, the tragedy, the strange power... and this
dream."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「全部、お前の｛・・／魔法｝なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is this all created by your magic power?"
dialogues.text: "Is this all created by your magic power?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね……うん……原因はボクにある」
dialogues.en: "I think so. Yes, I'm controlling all of these."
dialogues.text: "I think so. Yes, I'm controlling all of these."

dialogues.jp: 桜吹雪の中で静かなため息が漏れる。
dialogues.en: I sigh quietly, in the storm of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text: I sigh quietly, in the storm of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「ここはね――初音島は、ボクのために用意さ
　れた世界だから」
dialogues.en: "Because Hatsune Island is a world just for me."
dialogues.text: "Because Hatsune Island is a world just for me."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ボクの望みをスベテ叶える、魔法の世界」
dialogues.en: "This is the world that gives me anything I want."
dialogues.text: "This is the world that gives me anything I want."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……ばあちゃんか」
dialogues.en: "Your grandma..."
dialogues.text: "Your grandma..."

dialogues.jp: スベテというのなら、始まりはあの人だ。
dialogues.en:
If she says she's controlling everything, it must have
started with her.
dialogues.text:
If she says she's controlling everything, it must have
started with her.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「そう。おばあちゃんの夢でもある」
dialogues.en: "Yes. This is also my grandma's dream."
dialogues.text: "Yes. This is also my grandma's dream."

dialogues.jp: 悲しげにさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles sadly.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「魔法ってなんだと思う？」
dialogues.en: "What do you think about the magic power?"
dialogues.text: "What do you think about the magic power?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「魔法」
dialogues.en: "The magic."
dialogues.text: "The magic."

dialogues.jp: 魔法。
dialogues.en: The magic.
dialogues.text: The magic.

dialogues.jp: 「それって関係あるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that anything to do with Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Is that anything to do with Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「お前じゃなくて、俺の好きなさくらを助ける
　ために必要なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do I need it to save Sakura, I mean my Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Do I need it to save Sakura, I mean my Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「うん！　助けてあげて、ボクを！」
dialogues.en: "Yes! Please save me!"
dialogues.text: "Yes! Please save me!"

dialogues.jp: さくらの顔で、さくらじゃないナニカが微笑む。
dialogues.en: She gives me a smile like my Sakura usually does.
dialogues.text: She gives me a smile like my Sakura usually does.

dialogues.jp:
それで――あぁ、バカみたいだけれど、こいつ
を信じることにした。
dialogues.en: Well, it sounds ridiculous, but I decide to trust her.
dialogues.text: Well, it sounds ridiculous, but I decide to trust her.

dialogues.jp: 「魔法か……」
dialogues.en: "Magic power..."
dialogues.text: "Magic power..."

dialogues.jp: 「なんでも叶う力？」
dialogues.en: "You can have anything you want with that."
dialogues.text: "You can have anything you want with that."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「そう。願いを叶える力……簡単に説明しよう
　か」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. The power that makes your dreams come true... Let me
explain."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. The power that makes your dreams come true... Let me
explain."

dialogues.jp: 木の周りをぐるぐる、と回りながら。
dialogues.en: As she circles around the tree...
dialogues.text: As she circles around the tree...

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「魔法は想いの力……そんなモノはない。奇跡
　なんて起こらないと思っている人には、使え
　ない力」
dialogues.en:
"The magic means the power in your mind... But, it's not
true. You don't have it if you don't believe in it."
dialogues.text:
"The magic means the power in your mind... But, it's not
true. You don't have it if you don't believe in it."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「でもね……でも、みんな、心のどこかで願っ
　ているんだ」
dialogues.en: "But I don't know anyone who doesn't have a wish in them."
dialogues.text: "But I don't know anyone who doesn't have a wish in them."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前から逃げたい。普通は嫌だ。働くの
　は面倒だ。なんてツマラナイ。オモシロクナ
　イ。このセカイ」
dialogues.en:
"They want to get away from normality. They don't like
ordinariness. They don't want to work. This world is boring,
no fun..."
dialogues.text:
"They want to get away from normality. They don't like
ordinariness. They don't want to work. This world is boring,
no fun..."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「わくわくするような冒険がしたい……思い当
　たる節があるんじゃないかな？」
dialogues.en:
"They want adventure in their life. Does that sound
familiar?"
dialogues.text:
"They want adventure in their life. Does that sound
familiar?"

dialogues.jp: それは確かに、誰もが思うような愚痴だ。
dialogues.en: It sounds like everybody's complaints.
dialogues.text: It sounds like everybody's complaints.

dialogues.jp: そして夢。
dialogues.en: And dreams.
dialogues.text: And dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「そう。誰も信じていないのに。実は心のどこ
　かでみんなが望んでいる力が魔法」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. They don't believe it, but they always have a wish in
their mind. That's what magic's about."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. They don't believe it, but they always have a wish in
their mind. That's what magic's about."

dialogues.jp: 心を読んでいるように、ナニカが後を続ける。
dialogues.en: She keeps talking as if she were reading my mind.
dialogues.text: She keeps talking as if she were reading my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「だから、おばあちゃんは考えたんだ……」
dialogues.en: "So, my grandma used to think like this..."
dialogues.text: "So, my grandma used to think like this..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「ひとりひとりの力は小さいけれど、みんなの
　願いを少しづつ集めて、そんな力を、助けを、
　奇跡を必要とする人にあげようって」
dialogues.en:
"The power each person has is tiny. But when you put them
all together, you can share the power, and grant help and
miracles to whoever needs them."
dialogues.text:
"The power each person has is tiny. But when you put them
all together, you can share the power, and grant help and
miracles to whoever needs them."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「それが、この島の魔法」
dialogues.en: "That is the magic of this island."
dialogues.text: "That is the magic of this island."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「メルヘンだよ……みんなの力を集めて、ひと
　りを助けようっていう幸せな世界」
dialogues.en:
"It's like a fairy tale. All that power gathered together
could save a person's life. What a happy world we live in."
dialogues.text:
"It's like a fairy tale. All that power gathered together
could save a person's life. What a happy world we live in."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……集めるって」
dialogues.en: "Gather..."
dialogues.text: "Gather..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「うん。その願いを集めているのが――」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Their wishing powers are gathered by..."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Their wishing powers are gathered by..."

dialogues.jp: 手を掲げて、風に舞う桜を掴む。
dialogues.en: She grabs some cherry petals fluttering in the wind.
dialogues.text: She grabs some cherry petals fluttering in the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「――この枯れない桜と花びら達」
dialogues.en: "This cherry blossom that doesn't ever die, and its petals."
dialogues.text: "This cherry blossom that doesn't ever die, and its petals."

dialogues.jp:
その手を開くと、花びらではなく、赤い光の粒
子が空中に弾けた。
dialogues.en:
When she opened her palm, not petals but particles of red
light burst out in the air.
dialogues.text:
When she opened her palm, not petals but particles of red
light burst out in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「桜を見ている人が浮かべるきれいな感情、人
　が寝ている時に無意識に見る願いの形――夢
　の収集。これらを桜本体に流しているの」
dialogues.en:
"The feelings that you have when you see the beautiful
cherry blossoms. The wishes you have unconsciously when you
are asleep. I collect these from dreams, and transfer them
into to the cherry petals."
dialogues.text:
"The feelings that you have when you see the beautiful
cherry blossoms. The wishes you have unconsciously when you
are asleep. I collect these from dreams, and transfer them
into to the cherry petals."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「夢を流す？」
dialogues.en: "Transfer a dream?"
dialogues.text: "Transfer a dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだね。お兄ちゃんが見る他人の夢を
　見る力っていうのは、その副産物」
dialogues.en:
"Oh yes. The way you see other people's dreams is the
byproduct of this."
dialogues.text:
"Oh yes. The way you see other people's dreams is the
byproduct of this."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「魔法使いの血を持つワタシとお兄ちゃんを、
　夢の伝達経路と誤認して通してしまうの……
　導管なんだね」
dialogues.en:
"Sometimes I accidentally let the dreams pass through you
and me as a channel, because we have the witch's genes."
dialogues.text:
"Sometimes I accidentally let the dreams pass through you
and me as a channel, because we have the witch's genes."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「だから、テレビを見せられているようなもの
　だから、ワタシ達の見る夢は、基本的に思い
　のままにはならない」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, it's kind of like watching a TV program, so we
can't control our dream as we wish."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, it's kind of like watching a TV program, so we
can't control our dream as we wish."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、ここは、やさしい魔法の島なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, this is the cozy magical island that we live on."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, this is the cozy magical island that we live on."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「それが……」
確かに、聞いているだけならば問題ない。
dialogues.en:
From what she says, it doesn't seem like there should be
problems.
dialogues.text:
From what she says, it doesn't seem like there should be
problems.

dialogues.jp:
「それが、どうしてこんなに事件を起こすん
　だ？」
dialogues.en: "But I don't understand why she caused so much trouble."
dialogues.text: "But I don't understand why she caused so much trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「夢のせいだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's because of the dream."
dialogues.text: "It's because of the dream."

dialogues.jp: 即答する声に影はなく、しかし足音寂しく。
dialogues.en: She answers clearly, but sadly.
dialogues.text: She answers clearly, but sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「夢、願い、希望を叶える……ひとつだけ……
　この｛システム／魔法｝には致命的な｛バグ／問題｝があったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The dream, a wish to come true... There was one fatal
problem in the system of the magic power."
dialogues.text:
"The dream, a wish to come true... There was one fatal
problem in the system of the magic power."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「それが芳乃さくらだったんだ……」
dialogues.en: "It was Sakura Yoshino."
dialogues.text: "It was Sakura Yoshino."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが問題？
dialogues.en: Is Sakura a problem?
dialogues.text: Is Sakura a problem?

dialogues.jp: そのナニカは、薄く悲しげに笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiles slightly and sadly.
dialogues.text: She smiles slightly and sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「ワタシには魔法使いの血が流れていて、他の
　人のような、ちょっとした可能性への手助けっ
　てレベルにはならなかった」
dialogues.en:
"I have witch's blood, but it didn't grow to the level
needed to help out others."
dialogues.text:
"I have witch's blood, but it didn't grow to the level
needed to help out others."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「たとえばボクの悪口を言ってる人がいて、そ
　の人のことを傷つける考えも……願いになっ
　てしまった」
dialogues.en:
"For example, when somebody talked negatively about me, I
thought about getting the person hurt, but it always turned
out as I wished."
dialogues.text:
"For example, when somebody talked negatively about me, I
thought about getting the person hurt, but it always turned
out as I wished."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「遠足の班決めの些細ないさかいも、外見の子
　供っぽさを指摘されることも、自分の夢を潰
　そうとする存在も……」
dialogues.en:
"Like a little disagreement on a field trip, pointing out
how childish I am, or trying to destroy my dream..."
dialogues.text:
"Like a little disagreement on a field trip, pointing out
how childish I am, or trying to destroy my dream..."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ただ……邪魔だった、から……」
dialogues.en: "Because it just bothered you..."
dialogues.text: "Because it just bothered you..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「彼女がそれほど意識していなくても、かすか
　な願いでも現実に作用する」
dialogues.en:
"It worked with a little wish even if I wasn't conscious
about what I was thinking."
dialogues.text:
"It worked with a little wish even if I wasn't conscious
about what I was thinking."

dialogues.jp: 考えてしまうだけで？
dialogues.en: Just by thinking?
dialogues.text: Just by thinking?

dialogues.jp: そんなこと普通の人間が我慢できるはずがない。
dialogues.en:
That's insane for a normal human being to be able to do
that.
dialogues.text:
That's insane for a normal human being to be able to do
that.

dialogues.jp:
どんな聖人君主だって、完全に欲望を消し去る
ことは不可能だ。
dialogues.en:
Even a paragon of all virtues can't completely get rid of
all desires.
dialogues.text:
Even a paragon of all virtues can't completely get rid of
all desires.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「だからいつも、彼女は子供を演じていなけれ
　ばならなかった」
dialogues.en: "So she had to act like a child."
dialogues.text: "So she had to act like a child."

dialogues.jp: ガンガンと頭が痛む。
dialogues.en: My head aches terribly.
dialogues.text: My head aches terribly.

dialogues.jp:
「……だから笑って、子供っぽく振舞っていた
　のか！？」
dialogues.en: "Is that why she was always smiling childishly?"
dialogues.text: "Is that why she was always smiling childishly?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ。それが外見にも影響を及ぼした」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it is. And it affected her appearance, too."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it is. And it affected her appearance, too."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「外見って……」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by her appearance?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by her appearance?"

dialogues.jp: ６年前と同じ……って、まさか。
dialogues.en: She hasn't changed since six years ago... Oh, no.
dialogues.text: She hasn't changed since six years ago... Oh, no.

dialogues.jp: 「６年前にあいつがこの島を離れたのは……」
dialogues.en: "She left this island six years ago, because..."
dialogues.text: "She left this island six years ago, because..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that's right."
dialogues.text: "Yes, that's right."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「いつか自分が、両親や友達、あなたや音夢ちゃ
　んに危害を与えるかも知れなかったから」
dialogues.en:
"She was afraid that someday, she might cause harm to her
parents, Nemu-chan and you."
dialogues.text:
"She was afraid that someday, she might cause harm to her
parents, Nemu-chan and you."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「万能になったものは、神にならなければいけ
　なかったんだ」
dialogues.en: "Whoever becomes omnipotent has to become God."
dialogues.text: "Whoever becomes omnipotent has to become God."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「誰にも触れられず、誰にも見えず、誰にも声
　をかけられず……ただ、そこに存在してなく
　てはならなかった」
dialogues.en:
"The person has to exist without being touched, seen, and
talked..."
dialogues.text:
"The person has to exist without being touched, seen, and
talked..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「彼女はひとりだった……誰とも遊ぶことは出
　来ず、学問に集中したのだって、相手がいな
　かったからさ」
dialogues.en:
"She was alone... she didn't play with anybody, so she
focused on her study because she wasn't allowed to have
anybody around her."
dialogues.text:
"She was alone... she didn't play with anybody, so she
focused on her study because she wasn't allowed to have
anybody around her."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「彼女は無限よりもひとつだけ小さな神様になっ
　てしまったんだ」
dialogues.en: "She became God in a little smaller scale than eternity."
dialogues.text: "She became God in a little smaller scale than eternity."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、それはお前のせいじゃない！」
dialogues.en: "But it's not your fault!"
dialogues.text: "But it's not your fault!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「そう。原因は違う。でもワタシの問題だった」
dialogues.en: "I know. It was not my fault but my problem."
dialogues.text: "I know. It was not my fault but my problem."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「それに根源――そんなことは彼女の問題では
　ない。あなたが考えているよりも、彼女の問
　題は実際は浅く単純で、心は傷ついている」
dialogues.en:
"And the source of the problem is something different. Her
problem is actually lighter and less complicated than you
think... and yet she has a pain in her soul."
dialogues.text:
"And the source of the problem is something different. Her
problem is actually lighter and less complicated than you
think... and yet she has a pain in her soul."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "What did you say?"
dialogues.text: "What did you say?"

dialogues.jp: 浅くて単純？
dialogues.en: Lighter and less complicated...
dialogues.text: Lighter and less complicated...

dialogues.jp:
今まで聞いていた話とのギャップが激しくて、
意識が戻った。
dialogues.en:
I come back to myself at the tremendous gap between what
I've heard before and what she's saying now.
dialogues.text:
I come back to myself at the tremendous gap between what
I've heard before and what she's saying now.

dialogues.jp: と、ソレが夜空を見上げる。
dialogues.en: She looks up to the sky.
dialogues.text: She looks up to the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「……あぁ、彼女に気づかれてしまった」
dialogues.en: "Oh, she's noticed who I am."
dialogues.text: "Oh, she's noticed who I am."

dialogues.jp:
素っ気無い言葉とともに、微かにソレの姿がに
じむ。
dialogues.en: With those sudden words, the image of her blurs.
dialogues.text: With those sudden words, the image of her blurs.

dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……もうおしまい」
dialogues.en: "This is it."
dialogues.text: "This is it."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと待て！　なんだよ、さくらが傷つい
　ている単純な問題って！？」
dialogues.en: "Wait! What's the problem Sakura suffers?"
dialogues.text: "Wait! What's the problem Sakura suffers?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「この年頃の女の子の悩みといったら、決まっ
　てるじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"You should know the problem that girls of her age usually
have."
dialogues.text:
"You should know the problem that girls of her age usually
have."

dialogues.jp: くすくす、とソレが｛じちょう／自嘲｝する。
dialogues.en: She sneers at herself.
dialogues.text: She sneers at herself.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「例えば子供心に……桜が枯れなければ、いつ
　でもあなたが自分の名前を想っていてくれるっ
　て考える」
dialogues.en:
"In her childish mind, she thought you would remember her as
long as the cherry blossoms stay in bloom."
dialogues.text:
"In her childish mind, she thought you would remember her as
long as the cherry blossoms stay in bloom."

dialogues.jp: さくら。
dialogues.en: Sakura.
dialogues.text: Sakura.

dialogues.jp: ――サクラ？
dialogues.en: Sakura?
dialogues.text: Sakura?

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「たったそれだけの願いの結果がこれだよ？」
dialogues.en: "That little wish has resulted in all this."
dialogues.text: "That little wish has resulted in all this."

dialogues.jp: 枯れなくなった桜。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossom that won't ever die.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom that won't ever die.

dialogues.jp: 舞い散る花びらを見上げて、呆然としてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Looking up at the cherry petals falling down, I'm
speechless.
dialogues.text:
Looking up at the cherry petals falling down, I'm
speechless.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「人を助けてもテストでいい点をとっても、美
　味しい物を食べても……どんな幸せなことも
　自分の力で手に入れたものかも分からない」
dialogues.en:
"Helping others, scoring high in exams, eating good food...
She doesn't know whether she got those by her own will or
not."
dialogues.text:
"Helping others, scoring high in exams, eating good food...
She doesn't know whether she got those by her own will or
not."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「彼女にとっては、もう、この世界そのものが
　信じられないんだ」
dialogues.en: "She can't trust this world any more."
dialogues.text: "She can't trust this world any more."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「どこまでが自分の力で得たもので、どこまで
　が魔法の力なのか分からない」
dialogues.en:
"She doesn't know whether she got anything by her own will
or by the magic power."
dialogues.text:
"She doesn't know whether she got anything by her own will
or by the magic power."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「幸せも、不幸もない……夢と現実の境界すら
　ない」
dialogues.en:
"There is no boundary between happiness and catastrophe,
dream and reality."
dialogues.text:
"There is no boundary between happiness and catastrophe,
dream and reality."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「いや、自分の存在そのものが信じられないだ
　ろうに……本当に｛・・・・・／芳乃さくら｝という少女は存
　在するのかと」
dialogues.en:
"I think she must be dubious about her own existence,
wondering if 'Sakura Yoshino' really exists."
dialogues.text:
"I think she must be dubious about her own existence,
wondering if 'Sakura Yoshino' really exists."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「そして一番皮肉なのは……彼女はいつでも、
　この夢から自分で覚めることが出来るんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"And the greatest irony is that she can wake up from this
dream by her own will."
dialogues.text:
"And the greatest irony is that she can wake up from this
dream by her own will."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 自分で覚めることが出来る？
dialogues.en: Can she wake up from this dream?
dialogues.text: Can she wake up from this dream?

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「なんでも叶えられるなら、枯れない桜を、自
　分の手で枯らせばいいんだ」
dialogues.en:
"She can make things happen, so she can make the cherry
blossom die any time."
dialogues.text:
"She can make things happen, so she can make the cherry
blossom die any time."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ……どうして？」
dialogues.en: "But, why?"
dialogues.text: "But, why?"

dialogues.jp: ｛あぜん／唖然｝とする中で、景色が白く染まってゆく。
dialogues.en: As I feel dumbfounded, everything turns white.
dialogues.text: As I feel dumbfounded, everything turns white.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「これが彼女の問題の最大のポイントさ。ヒン
　トとも呼べる」
dialogues.en:
"This is the biggest problem she has. But you could call it
a clue."
dialogues.text:
"This is the biggest problem she has. But you could call it
a clue."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「ね、これを、未完成の魔法使いの見るバカら
　しい夢として考えるんじゃないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't think that this is some stupid dream created by an
incomplete witch."
dialogues.text:
"Don't think that this is some stupid dream created by an
incomplete witch."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「この夢を見ているのは、可愛らしい、見かけ
　よりもずっと弱い女の子なんだよ……」
dialogues.en:
"This is the dream of a sweeter and more fragile girl than
you think."
dialogues.text:
"This is the dream of a sweeter and more fragile girl than
you think."

dialogues.jp:
この年頃の女の子の悩みといったら、決まって
るじゃないか――さきほども、そんなことを言っ
ていた。
dialogues.en: It's obvious what the main problem for girls of this age is.
dialogues.text: It's obvious what the main problem for girls of this age is.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「さて、ダ・カーポみたいに、いつ終わるのか
　分からない夢物語の――」
dialogues.en:
"It's like a Da Capo, endlessly repeating without ever
knowing the ending..."
dialogues.text:
"It's like a Da Capo, endlessly repeating without ever
knowing the ending..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「閉幕」
dialogues.en: "Bring down the curtain."
dialogues.text: "Bring down the curtain."

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆Girl in the dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Girl in the dream◆

dialogues.jp: 夢の中で、さくらの姿をしたナニカに出会った。
dialogues.en: I met someone who looked like Sakura in a dream.
dialogues.text: I met someone who looked like Sakura in a dream.

dialogues.jp:
そいつは、この島の枯れない桜が持つ、人の願
いを叶えるという｛システム／魔法｝の説明をする。
dialogues.en:
She explained to me about the magic power, which makes the
cherry blossoms never die on this island, or which makes our
wish come true.
dialogues.text:
She explained to me about the magic power, which makes the
cherry blossoms never die on this island, or which makes our
wish come true.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その力のためにさくらが苦しんでいる
と。
dialogues.en: And Sakura is suffering because of that power.
dialogues.text: And Sakura is suffering because of that power.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そんなふざけた力なんて関係なく、さく
らが好きで、愛していて、助けてやりたかった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't care less about those ridiculous powers. I like
her dearly, love her, and wanted to save her no matter what.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't care less about those ridiculous powers. I like
her dearly, love her, and wanted to save her no matter what.
